checks: The normalized base mean is the first interior index after translation/reflection. Balance and concavity give w=(1+2t,s,1,t), 1+t≤s≤2−t, and 0<t≤1/2. The transformed zero height moment and endpoint Jensen bounds make the central trace strictly proper.

Both polynomial branches of 4Q−3mM were expanded independently. Their derivative signs on the feasible s range and endpoint values give nonnegativity. With no full fiber the exact capture sum therefore pays at least 3M/8.

A full left interval or full right inner interval pays at least M/4 away from the central trace; lower-roof convexity forces the right outer interval full in the latter case. Cauchy gives at least M/8 centrally.

For the right outer interval alone, upper-roof concavity gives D≤2C−B and C>0. The moment upper bound with K=max(1+2t,s−t) gives F≥Q/(2K)+t; independent expansion checked both remaining polynomial branches and their endpoint evaluation.

The pure-base cuts retain the whole center and each captures more than M/2. A nonvertical cut has zero boundary length on each sampled interval, including the threshold equalities classified as full. Original b9d705e0e5ad374f §§1–6 has the same four-site claim and full captured-pattern scope.

overlap.comparison: Its arbitrary-fiber integer centroid result gives the smaller universal threshold strictly above one third. It does not imply the stronger 3/8 constant for four positive sites.
It gives the central trace inequality and finite captured-pattern LPs at fixed feasible widths. The reviewed proof establishes the uniform 3/8 bound across the entire four-site width region.
